content:
Owen Park: Rolling canary for serving v5.2.0 in 10m. 5% -> 20 -> 60. Keep paid routes pinned.
Sofia Martinez: Pin version v5.2.0 for canary; rollback target v5.1.8. Noted.
Nina Rao: Add explicit gating: block promotion on kernel-fallback events > 3 in 5m. We saw surprises last week.
Owen Park: Agreed. Gate = (p95 >= 250ms for 3m) OR (kernel-fallback_count >=3 in 5m) OR (error_rate >= 0.5%).
DevOps Bot: Deploybot: scheduled rollout at 05:30 UTC for serving v5.2.0. Auto-revert disabled for first 12m per request.
ops-oncall: Who owns rollback for first 30m?
Owen Park: ops-oncall primary. release-engineer standby for comms.
release-engineer: I'll draft release note blurb and a minimal customer FAQ: "temporary pause if performance regresses".
DevOps Bot: Canary shift started: 5% -> v5.2.0. Baseline p95=110ms, error_rate=0.02%, kernel-fallback=0.
ops-oncall: Monitoring. :eyes:
DevOps Bot: Canary metrics 04:37: p95=270ms sustained 3m, kernel-fallback_count=1, error_rate=0.04%. Alert: p95 threshold breached.
nina rao: (typo) Nina Rao: Looking at traces — I see two fallback traces hitting `optimized-attn` -> fallback kernel on worker-7 causing queueing.
ops-oncall: Pause promotion, opening bridge.
Owen Park: Given p95 breach AND kernel fallback evidence, ops-oncall you have authority to revert canary.
ops-oncall: Executing canary revert now:
```
/ops/release revert --to v5.1.8 --scope canary --confirm
```
DevOps Bot: Revert acknowledged. Rolling canary back to v5.1.8.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary traffic off v5.2.0. p95 recovering to 115ms.
release-engineer: Holding public release notes: message will say "paused rollout for investigation, no paid-customer impact."
Sofia Martinez: Follow-ups: add kernel-fallback counter to rollout gating and surface worker IDs in alert. I'll open the PR.
Nina Rao: I'll collect traces and create runtime ticket with stack dumps.
Owen Park: Thanks all. Manual rollback executed, gating update planned. Reattempt after kernel patch and a fresh smoke pass. :thumbsup:
